Prashant Kishor wins Bankipur bypoll; Congress leads in Datia

Prashant Kishor, leading the Jan Suraaj campaign, secured a victory in the Bankipur assembly by-election, defeating the BJP. Kishor won by a margin of 19,324 votes. In the Datia by-election, Congress candidate Ghanshyam Singh established a significant lead of 12,607 votes, with initial trends indicating a win. The Bankipur seat, a BJP stronghold, was lost by the party after 31 years. The results are being analyzed for their potential impact on state politics, including shifts in leadership and party strategies.
